```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse=TRUE, comment="#>")
library(CCAflow)
```

The teaching layer connects algebra, interpretation and geometry.

```{r, eval=requireNamespace("ggplot2",quietly=TRUE)}
lab <- cca_teach(level="advanced",seed=3)
tr <- cca_guided_tour(lab$fit,"x",frames=25)
keys <- cca_tour_keyframes(tr,n=5,plots=TRUE)
keys$plots[[1]]
```

When `spinifex` is installed, the retained basis path can be rendered dynamically with `cca_tour_render(tr, engine="spinifex")`.
